You can summon/deploy a Cost 6 or less "Idol" family card, besides any "Kazesawa Sora", from your Trash without paying the cost. When this effect summoned a "Stage Style" family Spirit, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.

[LV2][LV3] [Constellation Appeal] (When Attacks/Blocks)
By sending [Soul Core] from this Spirit to the Trash, during this turn, up to two opposing Spirits can't attack/block.

CB14-012.name: ［Resort Cancer Coord］Natsuki Mikuru
CB14-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can return a Magic card from your Trash to the Hand. Or, you can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add every Magic card among them to your Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] [Constellation Appeal] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by sending [Soul Core] from this Spirit to the Trash, immediately use the Flash effect of a Yellow Magic card from your Hand without paying the cost, and refresh this Spirit.

CB14-X03.name: ［Rock My Heart Coord］Sakuraba Rola
CB14-X03.effect:

Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. Then, by sending [Soul Core] from this Spirit to the Trash, during this turn, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects, and can't be blocked.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By returning a "Sakuraba Rola"/"Nijino Yume" from your Hand/Trash to the deckbottom, refresh this Spirit.

CB14-020.name: ［Señorita Scheherazade Coord］Kurebayashi Juri
CB14-020.effect:

During this turn, give three opposing Spirits -10000 BP, and destroy them when they are brought to 0 BP.

[LV3] [Fever Appeal] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core] from this Spirit to the Trash, draw three cards. This effect can only be used once per turn.

CB14-017.name: ［Silky Love Devil Coord］Daichi Nono
CB14-017.effect:
When your "Shirakaba Risa" is summoned, you can summon this card from your Hand, without paying the cost. When you've done so, draw a card. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV2][LV3] [Fever Appeal] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core] from this Spirit to the Trash, put a core from the Void to any Spirit you control. When you've done so, send the [Soul Core] from your Trash to any "Shirakaba Risa" you control.

CB14-016.name: ［Silky Love Devil Coord］Shirakaba Risa
CB14-016.effect:
When your "Daichi Nono" is summoned, you can summon this card from your Hand, without paying the cost. When you've done so, put one core from the Void to any Spirit you control. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV2][LV3] [Fever Appeal] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core] from this Spirit to the Trash, draw a card. When you've done so, send the [Soul Core] from your Trash to any "Daichi Nono" you control.

CB14-019.name: ［Soul Marionette Coord］Kurosawa Rin

[LV2][LV3] [Fever Appeal] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core] from this Spirit to the Trash, return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom.

CB14-045.name: ［Spicy Kitty Coord］Chouno Maika

CB14-043.name: ［Star Harmony Academy Uniform］Minato Mio

Return a "Stage Style" family "Yuuki Aine"/"Minato Mio" from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2] [Aikatsu On Stage] (When Attacks)
You can put a "Stage Style" family "Minato Mio" from your Hand face-up onto your Removed Zone. When you've done so, return this Spirit to your Hand, and summon the card you put onto your Removed Zone, without paying the cost.

CB14-041.name: ［Star Harmony Academy Uniform］Yuuki Aine
CB14-041.effect:

[LV2] [Aikatsu On Stage] (When Attacks)
You can put a "Stage Style" family "Yuuki Aine" from your Hand face-up onto your Removed Zone. When you've done so, return this Spirit to your Hand, and summon the card you put onto your Removed Zone, without paying the cost.

CB14-038.name: ［Sweet Dreams Coord］Hanazono Kirara

[LV2][LV3] [Star Appeal] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by sending [Soul Core] from this Spirit to the Trash, return an opposing Spirit to deckbottom, and refresh this Spirit.

CB14-021.name: ［Street Art Coord］Shinjou Hinaki
CB14-021.effect:
[team: Luminas]

When you activate [Fever Appeal], you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost. When you've done so, send the [Soul Core] from your Trash to any of your Spirits. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV2][LV3] [Fever Appeal] (When Attacks)

CB14-029.name: ［Sweet Limelight Coord］Saotome Ako

[LV2][LV3] [Star Appeal] (When Attacks)

CB14-CP02.name: ［Swing Gemini Coord］Otoshiro Seira

[team: 2wingS]

You can summon a "Hoshimiya Ichigo" from your Hand without paying the cost. When you've done so, during this turn, all [2wingS] Spirits you control are unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV2][LV3] [Constellation Appeal] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core] from this Spirit to the Trash, refresh an "Hoshimiya Ichigo" you control. When you've done so, at the end of battle, send [Soul Core] from the Trash to your "Hoshimiya Ichigo".

CB14-037.name: ［Tropical Beach Coord］Nikaidou Yuzu

[LV2][LV3] [Star Appeal] (When Attacks)

CB14-036.name: ［Tropical Hula Girl Coord］Nikaidou Yuzu

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)

[LV3] [Constellation Appeal] (When Attacks)

[team: Luminas]

Show your entire Hand to the opponent, and for each "Stage Style" family card among them, return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom.
